## Summary / 摘要

- What changed? / 這次改了什麼？
- Why is it needed? / 為什麼需要這次改動？

## Scope Check / 範圍檢查

- [ ] This PR only changes tracked source, docs, or governance files  
      此 PR 只修改已追蹤的原始碼、說明文件或治理文件
- [ ] No bulk artifacts, weights, reconstructions, training data, or packaged runtimes were added  
      沒有加入大量 artifact、weights、重建輸出、訓練資料或部署/runtime 包
- [ ] Any historical branch or reconstructed claim is explicitly labeled and evidence-backed  
      任何歷史 branch 或 reconstructed 聲明都已清楚標示，且有證據支撐

## Validation / 驗證

- Commands run / 執行過的命令：
- Expected / observed result / 預期與實際結果：
- For non-trivial PRs, after opening or marking ready, manually comment `@codex review`  
  對於非 trivial 的 PR，在建立後或從 draft 轉成 ready 後，請手動留言 `@codex review`

## History / Governance Impact / 歷史與治理影響

- [ ] No change to branch strategy  
      不影響 branch strategy
- [ ] Updates repo governance docs  
      有更新 repo 治理文件
- [ ] Adds or updates a reconstructed or semantic history branch  
      有新增或更新 reconstructed / semantic history branch

## References / 參考資料

- Formal docs / 正式文件：
- Reports / 報告：
- Related issue / 相關 issue：
